note: Working asset name only; no Dad character, rarity or catalog change.

coordinate_mapping.logical: (X,D,H): X left/right (left negative), D depth front 0 -> rear 48, H height above walking surface
coordinate_mapping.roblox_after_fbx: Roblox X = -Blender x, Roblox Y = Blender z, Roblox Z = Blender y (proven FBX axis settings); viewed from the front the logical +X is the owner's right.

counts.triangle_method: sum(max(vertices-2,0)) over evaluated meshes with modifiers applied

collision_hint.noncollide_note: Objects in noncollide_objects are set CanCollide=false by the Studio script; structural floor/walls/dry ground/main furniture/grill/fence bodies stay collidable.
collision_hint.mesh_fidelity: Roblox MeshPart CollisionFidelity left at Default; see VERIFICATION_RU.md

documented_adjustments: Side fences start at D=0.8 (not 0.6) so their first post abuts the front-fence corner post instead of overlapping it.
Connector for FamilyPad_02 uses D=13.1..16.1 (3 wide) to stay clear of the side loveseat (starts D=16.2).
Backing frames for story graphics sit at X=-14.60 (wall face) .. -14.58 so they touch the room-side wall plane.
